title: Lost Stories of Black Charleston Walking Tour
includes: Experience Mother Emanuel A.M. E. Church stories that have faded from memory over the centuries.
Tours narrated by writer, historian, educator, and licensed tour guide, Damon Fordham
Walk by historical Charleston sites such as Old Slave Mart Museum and the Heyward-Washington House
2-hour Lost Stories of Black Charleston Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Listen to the lost stories of black Charleston on this 2-hour walking tour. Hear forgotten folktales and learn about the heroes and heroines who were left out of the history books. Gain more understanding about Charleston's role in the nation's history on this enthralling walking tour.
